# kosha

> kosha (कोश) — a treasury of your repo and environment context for coding agents. FTS5 + vector search + call graph, no LLMs required.

## Modules

- [kosha.cli](https://vedicreader.github.io/kosha/cli.html.md): The `kosha` shell command: every index and graph query as a subcommand.
- [kosha.core](https://vedicreader.github.io/kosha/core.html.md): Index your repository and its installed packages, then search them by meaning or by keyword.
- [kosha.skill](https://vedicreader.github.io/kosha/skill.html.md): Search your repo and every installed package by meaning, then follow the call graph between them. Use it before you grep, open a source file, or write code a dependency already provides. Keyword search, vector search and a static call graph over local SQLite, with no LLM calls and no network.
